name: Feedback Saturation & Recovery Stress Test
description: Tests feedback saturation behavior and recovery. Ramps feedback from 95% → 98% → 50% to validate anti-overflow mechanisms, saturation handling, and graceful recovery from extreme feedback levels.

invariants.description: Peak level must not exceed 0dBFS — anti-overflow mechanisms must prevent clipping
Signal energy should be elevated during high feedback but not runaway
Feedback changes may cause brief discontinuities but should be controlled
DC offset must remain controlled even at extreme feedback levels
Tail should decay after feedback reduction (recovery test)

notes: This scenario validates that Echoform's anti-overflow mechanisms prevent runaway feedback.
Expected behavior: Signal level increases with feedback but never clips or explodes.
Recovery phase (12-15s) validates graceful return to normal operation after extreme feedback.
